568:t_3:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just kidding. You're still a kid about things like that.」

568:t_3:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「Yeah, yeah! Both $$シンジ$$ and $$ニコラ$$ are growing from boys into men!」

568:t_3:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「If you ever run into trouble, lean on us, your seniors in life.」

568:t_3:19.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'll tell you this, $$赤木$$... I'm going to grow up, but I have no intention of becoming an old guy.」

568:t_3:21.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Becoming an adult... Moving on toward the future...)

568:t_3:22.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I wonder if I have a future too...)

568:t_3:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we leave $$ニコラ$$ and $$シンジ$$ to $$赤木$$, they'll be fine.」

568:t_3:24.en:
$$青山$$
「A boy aiming to be an adult and an adult who can't shake his childishness seem to make a good match.」

568:t_3:25.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Still, to think $c was transferred because of $$シンジ$$'s wish...」

568:t_3:26.en:
$$桂$$
「The situation back then was a total mess.」

568:t_3:27.en:
$$桂$$
「The sensation of so many people's feelings swirling together was similar to the $$時空修復|lc$$ during the $$多元戦争$$, but the sheer chaos of it was on another level.」

568:t_3:28.en:
$$万丈$$
「The warping of the dimensional boundary line seems to have calmed for now, but there's no telling when something will happen again.」

568:t_3:29.en:
$$青山$$
「If we play it wrong, hordes of $$バアル$$ could come pouring out of that hole, is that it?」

568:t_3:30.en:
$$オルソン$$
「There's also a chance spacetime itself collapses before that.」

568:t_3:31.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Three keys... It seems the third $$特異点$$ was not Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$ after all.」

568:t_3:32.en:
$$オルソン$$
「She was a $$特異点$$ of the $$ウィスパード$$ phenomenon, but now that her ability is gone, we should assume the key the $$サイデリアル$$ speak of lies elsewhere.」

568:t_3:34.en:
$$桂$$
(Thanks to $$レナード$$ treating me as an enemy, I've started to see who that third one is...)

568:t_3:38.en:
$$桂$$
(If it's that person, I have to be careful. Having been in that group, they have to be seriously twisted...)

568:t_3:39.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The search for the three keys... So we're back to square one.」

568:t_3:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then the quickest way would be to ask the source of that information directly.」

568:t_3:41.en:
$$オルソン$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$, huh...」

568:t_3:42.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Because we came to the $$蒼の地球$$, each of the three Reactors made a move. As a result, the fronts in various regions have gradually thinned out.」

568:t_3:43.en:
$$万丈$$
「In the meantime, the preparations for a counteroffensive must have advanced too.」

568:t_3:44.en:
$$桂$$
「All that's left is judging when to give the GO, huh.」

568:t_3:45.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That black $$アンゲロイ$$ might show up there too...」

568:t_3:46.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's a good opportunity. I'd like to make the relationship between the fundamental calamity and the $$サイデリアル$$ clear soon, too.」

568:t_3:47.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But before that, we have to settle things.」

568:t_3:49.en:
$$オルソン$$
「They've lost strength too, with $$ハマーン・カーン$$ and $$ザフト$$ breaking away. They may come at us with a last-ditch strategy to turn things around.」

568:t_3:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The focal point of that battle will probably be the existence of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

568:t_3:51.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Something capable of overturning the very existence of the $$地球連邦$$...」

568:t_3:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If it falls into $$フル・フロンタル$$'s hands, cunning as he is... he'll use it as material to break the anti-Empire forces everywhere.」

568:t_3:53.en:
$$万丈$$
「At this point in time, that is the one thing I want to avoid.」

568:t_3:54.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't like the sound of that... That guy always goes for these realistic schemes.」

568:t_3:55.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That's what sets him apart from Colonel $$シャア$$, who's so full of romance.」

568:t_3:56.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Not that I understand the whole 'men's romance' thing myself.」

568:t_3:57.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you're the same as $$ハマーン・カーン$$, then.」

568:t_3:58.en:
$$いぶき$$
「But the fact that she forgives a colonel like that shows even the Iron Lady is a woman after all.」

568:t_3:59.en:
$$青山$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$, a thorough realist, will surely pull one last scheme.」

568:t_3:60.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To meet that head-on, I hear $c will finish resupplying aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

568:t_3:61.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So that place will be the site of the decisive battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...」

568:t_3:62.en:
$$桂$$
「So the fight over $$ラプラスの箱$$ that started with the $$時獄戦役$$ is finally reaching its climax.」

568:t_3:63.en:
$$青山$$
「It may be inappropriate, but having come this far, I'm curious what's actually inside the box.」

568:t_3:64.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Whether to disclose it should be left to the judgment of those who were entrusted with the box.」

568:t_3:65.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$バナージ$$ and Her Highness $$ミネバ$$, then.」

568:t_3:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I want to believe those two will use that power to carry on toward the future...」

568:t_3:70.en: ～ $$ネオ・ジオン$$ Leader's Private Room ～

568:t_3:71.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Does the fact that you told me the truth mean you acknowledge me as humanity's successor?」

568:t_3:72.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That depends on you from here on.」

568:t_3:73.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Understood. Then I will show you that I can seal the box by my own power.」

568:t_3:74.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「In order to save humanity from despair.」

568:t_3:75.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be looking forward to it.」

568:t_3:78.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But perhaps that is the limit of humanity...」

568:t_3:79.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(So that is how it is, $$シャア・アズナブル$$... and $$バナージ$$...)

568:t_3:80.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(The battle that decides our future, and humanity's at the same time, seems to be coming to an end.)

568:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As shop owner $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, we will be running the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ under our caretaker service.」

568:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

568:t_10:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I heard the owner is a very amusing person and was looking forward to it, but what a shame.」

568:t_10:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then, Big Sis, I'll take care of that...!」

568:t_10:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's give it our all again toooooday!」

568:t_10:14.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「$$オオタ・カズミ$$... Registration complete.」

568:t_10:16.en:
$n
(Don't tell me... you got caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$...)

569:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I have confirmed all $c ships and every unit of the mobile force. Everyone is safe.」

569:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In other words, everyone who was there was sent to this red land.」

569:t_000:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「We've received contact from $$アスカ$$. She says the EVA pilots are all in one place.」

569:t_000:3.en:
$$ラム$$
「She also says this is their own world.」
